summary: Fantasy action-RPG series set around Ancaria, later branching into brawler and mobile spin-offs under Deep Silver.

entries.title: Sacred

emulation.notes: No emulation needed; use the Windows PC version with compatibility settings or community fixes if required.

primary.version: Sacred Gold with Sacred Plus and Sacred Underworld
primary.why: The Windows Sacred Gold package is the most complete and practical capture route, bundling the base game, Sacred Plus, and the Underworld expansion.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sacred Gold on Windows through Steam or GOG; use PC compatibility fixes only as needed for modern Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster; expect compatibility work on current Windows.

entries.title: Sacred 2: Fallen Angel

emulation.notes: Use the Windows remaster natively; original PS3/Xbox 360 releases are archival-only unless documenting console-era differences.

primary.why: The 2025 Windows remaster includes all expansions and updates with enhanced textures, lighting, view distance, controller support, UI work, stability fixes, and native PC capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sacred 2 Remaster on Windows through Steam or GOG for the full modern package; use the original Xbox 360 version only if documenting its small platform-specific DLC.

secondary.exclusive_content: A platform-specific inventory-storage creature/DLC tied to the original Xbox 360 release.
secondary.what_to_play: Only check this version for archival documentation of that DLC; do the main playthrough on the Windows remaster.
secondary.why: The original console row has a minor content difference, while the remaster is otherwise the best complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remaster is the modern definitive route, but original-version purists may still compare it against Sacred 2 Gold/community-patched PC because it changes presentation, UI, and feel.

entries.title: Sacred Citadel
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with Jungle Hunt DLC

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary version.

primary.version: Steam PC version with Jungle Hunt DLC
primary.why: The Windows version is the easiest high-quality capture route and can include the Jungle Hunt add-on without relying on seventh-generation console storefronts.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Steam version and include Jungle Hunt if covering the complete brawler side-story.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; this is a spin-off brawler rather than a mainline ARPG.

entries.title: Sacred 3

primary.version: Sacred 3 Gold Edition with all DLC
primary.why: Windows has the highest-fidelity version and the Gold Edition bundles the base game with all DLC, artbook, and soundtrack.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sacred 3 Gold Edition on Windows/Steam for the complete package; console versions are only needed for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; note that this entry changes genre structure toward co-op brawler/action rather than the open ARPG design of Sacred and Sacred 2.

entries.title: Sacred Legends
entries.definitive_edition: No definitive edition; original mobile release only

emulation.notes: Use only a legal install or owned-library download; otherwise keep coverage archival.

primary.why: The game was released only for iOS and Android; Android is the more flexible archival/capture route when the app can be obtained legally.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Android version on real hardware or an Android capture setup if the app is still available from an owned library; otherwise document it from footage and public sources instead of fabricating a playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: Availability may depend on mobile store/library status; do not claim a live-service playthrough unless the app is actually accessible.
